subject: Concealing cables and equipment
hook: New console at Christmas? A lift-out panel means you will not be pulling the unit off the wall.
ig:
New console at Christmas? A lift-out panel means you will not be pulling the unit off the wall.

The most overlooked part of a media unit is what happens a year after it is fitted. Equipment changes. A new router arrives, a games console appears, the soundbar gets upgraded. If every cable was sealed in on day one, getting to them is a real job.

So we build in two small details:
• A removable panel behind the equipment shelf, so the cable void can be reached from the front
• Cable grommets placed exactly where each device sits, which keep the holes neat and stop cables rubbing on raw edges

Together they mean the unit stays tidy for years, not just for the handover photo.

If you are already planning a media wall, save this so you remember to ask your maker about access.
